name: Finish Robotics ANDY autonomous coating system
summary: Autonomous wall coating robot that is set on a wall, maps the surface and paints it without human intervention, working alongside a painting crew. Offered by the US start-up Finish Robotics for hire by the day, with technician training.

germany.statusNote: Offered in the USA as a hire service ('as little as one day') with technician training and certification; enquiries by contact form. No German or EU route found.

specs.label: Operation
specs.value: maps the wall surface and paints it autonomously
specs.quote: Set ANDY on a wall and he autonomously maps the surface and paints without human intervention.

specs.label: Commercial model
specs.value: hire, paid only while working, from one day
specs.quote: Best of all, you are only paying when he is working. Hire him for as little as one day.

notes: How ANDY moves along the wall is not described on readable pages, so no drive type is set.
Pitched for the largest projects and highest spaces, so the crew can stay on the ground (maker).
A 2026 industry list describes Finish Robotics as building autonomous plastering robots that apply and finish wall surfaces; the maker's own page speaks of painting and coating.
